info.headline: Notify NYC - Unplanned Road Closure - Grand Street Bridge (BK/QN)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-01-2026 at 03:38 PM.
Due to ongoing repairs, all lanes of the Grand Street Bridge are closed in both directions in Brooklyn and Queens. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
To view this message in American Sign Language (ASL), العربية, বাঙালি, 中文, Français, Kreyòl Ayisyen, Italiano, 한국어, Polski, Pусский, Español, اردو or ייִדיש : http://on.nyc.gov/2gnTjHH.
